SCS-01.description:
1 BHK PREMIUM DEEP CLEANING

Complete top-to-bottom deep cleaning of your 1 BHK home in Pune by a trained, supervised Sahara team.

WALLS: WALL DRY DUSTING • CEILING: CEILING DRY DUSTING
(Want walls washed? Choose PLATINUM — it adds WALL WET CLEANING.)

SCOPE OF WORK
• Window glass cleaning
• Sliding channel vacuuming
• Grill dusting
• Furniture exterior dusting & cleaning
• Sofa dry vacuuming
• Bathroom WC / commode cleaning
• Bathroom wall tiles & floor tiles cleaning
• Water taps & fittings deep cleaning
• Balcony deep cleaning
• Kitchen platform cleaning
• Kitchen tiles cleaning
• Exhaust fan cleaning
• Kitchen trolley exterior cleaning
• Lights & fans dusting
• Doors dusting
• Floor manual scrubbing & cleaning
• Cobweb & spider web removal
• WALL DRY DUSTING
• CEILING DRY DUSTING

EQUIPMENT / PROCESS
• Commercial vacuum cleaner
• Professional cleaning tools
• Microfiber system
• Appropriate cleaning chemicals
• Scrubbing machine where applicable

SERVICE DETAILS
Estimated duration: 7–8 hours (depends on home size and condition).

ADDITIONAL CHARGES
• Sofa, carpet and mattress shampoo / foam cleaning — quoted separately
• Chimney cleaning — quoted separately
• Any work outside the listed scope — quoted separately

EXCLUSIONS
• Wall wet cleaning (included in Platinum)
• Inaccessible areas
• Moving heavy furniture / fixtures

CUSTOMER REQUIREMENTS
• Water supply and electrical connection
• Stool / ladder where required
• Access to all areas to be cleaned
• Empty cabinets / wardrobes in advance if internal cleaning is requested

TERMS & CONDITIONS
1. Old, hard or permanent stains are not guaranteed to be removed completely. The team will attempt removal to the best of its ability without damaging the surface.
2. Inaccessible areas are outside the scope.
3. Wall wet cleaning is included only in the Platinum package — it is not part of Premium.
4. Internal cabinet / wardrobe cleaning (where requested) requires the customer to empty them in advance.
5. Sofa, carpet and mattress shampoo / foam cleaning are additional services unless specifically included.
6. Heavy furniture and fixtures are not moved unless separately agreed.
7. Customer to arrange stool / ladder, water supply and electrical connection where required.
8. Additional work outside the confirmed scope will be quoted separately.
9. Site conditions may affect the scope and time required.
10. Payment is due as per the agreed booking terms.
11. Images are representative.

Service area: East Pune — Hadapsar, Magarpatta, Amanora, Kharadi, Viman Nagar, Kalyani Nagar, Koregaon Park, Mundhwa, Wagholi, NIBM, Wanowrie, Kondhwa, Undri and nearby areas.
